source.zh: 垂謂之曰：「汝器識長進，非復吳下阿蒙也。」
source.en: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”
source.literal: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”

source.zh: 堅之敗也，堅與張夫人相失，慕容垂將護致之，德正色謂垂曰：「昔楚莊滅陳，納巫臣之諫而棄夏姬。
source.en: When Jian was defeated, he and Consort Zhang lost each other. Murong Chui was about to escort her back, but De, with a stern expression, said to Chui: “When King Zhuang of Chu destroyed Chen, he accepted Wu Chen’s remonstrance and cast aside Xia Ji.
source.literal: When Jian was defeated, he and Consort Zhang lost each other. Murong Chui was about to escort her back, but De, with a stern expression, said to Chui: “When King Zhuang of Chu destroyed Chen, he accepted Wu Chen’s remonstrance and cast aside Xia Ji.

source.zh: 章司馬丁建率眾來降，言章師老，可以敗之。
source.en: Ding Jian, chief clerk under Tuoba Zhang, defected with his troops and reported that Zhang's army was exhausted and vulnerable.
source.literal: Tuoba Zhang's chief clerk Ding Jian led his masses to surrender and said Tuoba Zhang's army was worn and could be defeated.

source.zh: 及魏軍未至，擁眾南渡，就魯陽王和，據滑台而聚兵積穀，伺隙而動，計之上也。
source.en: Before Wei’s army arrives, gather the host and cross south to join Prince of Luyang Murong He, occupy Huatai, mass troops, pile grain, and watch for an opening to move. This is the best plan.
source.literal: Before Wei’s army arrives, gather the host and cross south to join Prince of Luyang Murong He, occupy Huatai, mass troops, pile grain, and watch for an opening to move. This is the best plan.

source.zh: 吾亦以嗣帝奔亡，人神曠主，故權順群議，以系眾望。
source.en: I also, because the heir emperor had fled and men and spirits lacked a lord, temporarily followed the counsel of the crowd in order to hold the hopes of the multitude.
source.literal: I also, because the heir emperor had fled and men and spirits lacked a lord, temporarily followed the counsel of the crowd in order to hold the hopes of the multitude.

span.exact: Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhang Hua

source.zh: 其黃門侍郎張華進曰：「夫爭奪之世，非雄才不振；
source.en: His Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhang Hua stepped forward and said: “In an age of struggle, only heroic talent can rouse the realm;
source.literal: His Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhang Hua stepped forward and said: “In an age of struggle, only heroic talent can rouse the realm;

source.zh: 會熒惑守東井，或言秦當復興者，廣乃自稱秦王，敗德將慕容鐘。
source.en: Mars stood over Dongjing; some claimed Former Qin would revive. Fu Guang thereupon proclaimed himself King of Qin and routed Murong De's general Murong Zhong.
source.literal: When Mars occupied the Dongjing asterism, some said Qin would rise again; Guang then declared himself King of Qin and defeated De's general Murong Zhong.

source.zh: 逆賊辟閭渾父蔚，昔同段龕阻亂淄川，太宰東征，剿絕凶命。
source.en: The rebel Bi Lü Hun's father Wei once joined Duan Kan blocking chaos on the Zi River; the grand preceptor marched east and extirpated the wicked life.
source.literal: The rebel Bi Lü Hun's father Wei once joined Duan Kan blocking chaos on the Zi River; the grand preceptor marched east and extirpated the wicked life.

source.zh: 德母兄先在長安，遣平原人杜弘如長安問存否，弘曰：「臣至長安，若不奉太后動止，便即西如張掖，以死為效。
source.en: De's mother and elder brother were first in Chang'an; he sent Pingyuan man Du Hong to Chang'an to ask whether they still lived, and Hong said, 'If I reach Chang'an and do not bring back news of the empress dowager's condition, I will go west to Zhangye and die to prove my loyalty.
source.literal: De's mother and elder brother were first in Chang'an; he sent Pingyuan man Du Hong to Chang'an to ask whether they still lived, and Hong said, 'If I reach Chang'an and do not bring back news of the empress dowager's condition, I will go west to Zhangye and die to prove my loyalty.

source.zh: 臣父雄年逾六十，未沾榮貴，乞本縣之祿，以申烏鳥之情。」
source.en: My father Xiong is past sixty and has not tasted honor; I beg the salary of our home county to express the crow's filial heart.'
source.literal: My father Xiong is past sixty and has not tasted honor; I beg the salary of our home county to express the crow's filial heart.'

source.zh: 遂以謨從至漢城陽景王廟，宴庶老于申池，北登社首山，東望鼎足，因目牛山而歎曰：「古無不死！」
source.en: Thereupon he took Yan Mo along to the temple of Han Prince Jing of Chengyang, feasted the common elders at Shen Pool, climbed north Mount Sheshou, looked east at the tripod legs of terrain, then gazed at Mount Niu and sighed, saying, 'From antiquity there has been no not dying!'
source.literal: Thereupon he took Yan Mo along to the temple of Han Prince Jing of Chengyang, feasted the common elders at Shen Pool, climbed north Mount Sheshou, looked east at the tripod legs of terrain, then gazed at Mount Niu and sighed, saying, 'From antiquity there has been no not dying!'

source.zh: 邃答曰：「武王封比干之墓，漢祖祭信陵之墳，皆留心賢哲，每懷往事。
source.en: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou raised a mound over Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.
source.literal: Sui replied, 'King Wu of Zhou raised a mound over Bi Gan's tomb, Han's Gaozu sacrificed at Lord Xinling's grave—both fixed their hearts on worthies and often cherished old deeds.

source.zh: 德夜夢其父曰：「汝既無子，何不早立超為太子，不爾，惡人生心。」
source.en: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'
source.literal: De dreamed at night his father said, 'You have no son; why not early establish Chao as crown prince—otherwise evil men will breed designs.'
